import Mathlib

structure CycleGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def CycleGraph.well_formed (g : CycleGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def CycleGraph.size (g : CycleGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def CycleGraph.has_edge (g : CycleGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def CycleGraph.is_path (g : CycleGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def CycleGraph.is_cycle (g : CycleGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def CycleGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : CycleGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def has_cycle_precond (graph : CycleGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- successors of `u` as a list -/
def CycleGraph.succs (g : CycleGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList else []

/-- `reachB g k u` is `true` iff there is a walk of `k` edges starting at `u`. -/
def CycleGraph.reachB (g : CycleGraph) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => true
  | k + 1, u => (g.succs u).any (fun v => g.reachB k v)

/-- prepend a value to a walk function -/
def consF (u : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => u
  | j + 1 => f j

/-- `mkList f i m = [f i, f (i+1), ..., f (i+m)]` -/
def mkList : (Nat → Nat) → Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | f, i, 0 => [f i]
  | f, i, m + 1 => f i :: mkList f (i + 1) m
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def has_cycle (graph : CycleGraph)
    (h_precond : has_cycle_precond graph) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (List.range graph.adj.size).any (fun u => graph.reachB graph.adj.size u)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def has_cycle_postcond (graph : CycleGraph) (result : Bool)
    (_ : has_cycle_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

lemma listGetD_cons_zero (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first
    | (simp; done)
    | rfl
    | (simp [List.getD]; done)

lemma listGetD_cons_succ (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (k + 1) 0 = l.getD k 0 := by
  first
    | (simp; done)
    | rfl
    | (simp [List.getD]; done)

lemma list_head?_eq (l : List Nat) (h : 0 < l.length) :
    l.head? = some (l.getD 0 0) := by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t => simp [listGetD_cons_zero]

lemma list_getLast?_eq : ∀ (l : List Nat), 0 < l.length →
    l.getLast? = some (l.getD (l.length - 1) 0) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro _
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have h1 : ([a] : List Nat).getLast? = some a := by
        first
          | rfl
          | (simp; done)
      rw [h1]
      simp [listGetD_cons_zero]
    | cons b u =>
      have ih2 : (b :: u).getLast? = some ((b :: u).getD ((b :: u).length - 1) 0) :=
        ih (by simp)
      have key : (a :: b :: u).getLast? = (b :: u).getLast? := by
        first
          | rfl
          | (simp; done)
          | (rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]; done)
          | (simp [List.getLast?]; done)
          | (simp [List.getLast?, List.getLastD]; done)
          | (simp [List.getLast?, List.getLast]; done)
      have hlen : (a :: b :: u).length - 1 = ((b :: u).length - 1) + 1 := by simp
      rw [key, ih2, hlen, listGetD_cons_succ]

lemma mkList_length (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (m i : Nat), (mkList f i m).length = m + 1 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro i; simp [mkList]
  | succ mm ih => intro i; simp [mkList, ih]

lemma mkList_getD (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (m i k : Nat), k ≤ m →
    (mkList f i m).getD k 0 = f (i + k) := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro i k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
    subst hk0
    simp [mkList, listGetD_cons_zero]
  | succ mm ih =>
    intro i k hk
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [mkList, listGetD_cons_zero]
    | succ kk =>
      have h1 : kk ≤ mm := by omega
      have h2 := ih (i + 1) kk h1
      have h3 : mkList f i (mm + 1) = f i :: mkList f (i + 1) mm := by simp [mkList]
      rw [h3, listGetD_cons_succ, h2]
      congr 1
      omega

lemma mem_succs_iff (g : CycleGraph) (u v : Nat) :
    v ∈ g.succs u ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    by_cases h : u < g.adj.size
    · have hs : g.succs u = (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by
        first
          | (simp [CycleGraph.succs, h]; done)
          | (unfold CycleGraph.succs; rw [if_pos h])
      rw [hs] at hv
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      first
        | exact hv
        | (simpa using hv)
        | exact Array.mem_def.mpr hv
    · have hs : g.succs u = [] := by
        first
          | (simp [CycleGraph.succs, h]; done)
          | (unfold CycleGraph.succs; rw [if_neg h])
      rw [hs] at hv
      simp at hv
  · intro hv
    have hv' : u < g.adj.size ∧ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := hv
    have hs : g.succs u = (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by
      first
        | (simp [CycleGraph.succs, hv'.1]; done)
        | (unfold CycleGraph.succs; rw [if_pos hv'.1])
    rw [hs]
    first
      | exact hv'.2
      | (simpa using hv'.2)
      | exact Array.mem_def.mp hv'.2

lemma reachB_zero (g : CycleGraph) (u : Nat) : g.reachB 0 u = true := by
  first
    | rfl
    | (simp [CycleGraph.reachB]; done)

lemma reachB_succ (g : CycleGraph) (k u : Nat) :
    g.reachB (k + 1) u = (g.succs u).any (fun v => g.reachB k v) := by
  first
    | rfl
    | (simp [CycleGraph.reachB]; done)

lemma walk_of_reachB (g : CycleGraph) : ∀ (k u : Nat), g.reachB k u = true →
    ∃ f : Nat → Nat, f 0 = u ∧ ∀ i, i < k → g.has_edge (f i) (f (i + 1)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro u _
    exact ⟨fun _ => u, rfl, fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro u hu
    rw [reachB_succ, List.any_eq_true] at hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hrv⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfe⟩ := ih v hrv
    refine ⟨consF u f, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      have hedge : g.has_edge u v := (mem_succs_iff g u v).mp hv
      show g.has_edge u (f 0)
      rw [hf0]
      exact hedge
    | succ j =>
      show g.has_edge (f j) (f (j + 1))
      exact hfe j (by omega)

lemma reachB_of_walk (g : CycleGraph) : ∀ (k : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat),
    (∀ i, i < k → g.has_edge (f i) (f (i + 1))) → g.reachB k (f 0) = true := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro f _; exact reachB_zero g (f 0)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro f hf
    rw [reachB_succ, List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨f 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (mem_succs_iff g (f 0) (f 1)).mpr (hf 0 (Nat.succ_pos k))
    · have h2 := ih (fun i => f (i + 1)) (fun i hi => hf (i + 1) (by omega))
      exact h2

lemma sound_dir (g : CycleGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (h : (List.range g.adj.size).any (fun u => g.reachB g.adj.size u) = true) :
    g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hwf' : ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size := hwf
  rw [List.any_eq_true] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hru⟩ := h
  rw [List.mem_range] at hu
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfe⟩ := walk_of_reachB g g.adj.size u hru
  have hbound : ∀ i, i ≤ g.adj.size → f i < g.adj.size := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => rw [hf0]; exact hu
    | succ j =>
      have hj : j < g.adj.size := by omega
      have he' : f j < g.adj.size ∧ f (j + 1) ∈ g.adj.getD (f j) #[] := hfe j hj
      exact hwf' (f j) he'.1 (f (j + 1)) he'.2
  have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (g.adj.size + 1), f a ∈ Finset.range g.adj.size := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact hbound a (by omega)
  have hcard : (Finset.range g.adj.size).card < (Finset.range (g.adj.size + 1)).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_range, Finset.card_range]; omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hne, heq⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hcard hmaps
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj, hfij⟩ :
      ∃ i j, i < j ∧ i ≤ g.adj.size ∧ j ≤ g.adj.size ∧ f i = f j := by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x y with hlt | hge
    · exact ⟨x, y, hlt, by omega, by omega, heq⟩
    · exact ⟨y, x, by omega, by omega, by omega, heq.symm⟩
  have hL : (mkList f i (j - i)).length = (j - i) + 1 := mkList_length f (j - i) i
  refine ⟨mkList f i (j - i), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hL]; omega
  · intro idx hidx
    rw [hL] at hidx
    have h1 : idx ≤ j - i := by omega
    have h2 : idx + 1 ≤ j - i := by omega
    rw [mkList_getD f (j - i) i idx h1, mkList_getD f (j - i) i (idx + 1) h2]
    have h3 : i + (idx + 1) = (i + idx) + 1 := by omega
    rw [h3]
    exact hfe (i + idx) (by omega)
  · rw [hL]; omega
  · have hpos : 0 < (mkList f i (j - i)).length := by rw [hL]; omega
    rw [list_head?_eq _ hpos, list_getLast?_eq _ hpos]
    have hidx : (mkList f i (j - i)).length - 1 = j - i := by simp [hL]
    rw [hidx, mkList_getD f (j - i) i 0 (by omega),
      mkList_getD f (j - i) i (j - i) (le_refl _)]
    have e2 : i + (j - i) = j := by omega
    rw [e2, Nat.add_zero, hfij]

lemma complete_dir (g : CycleGraph) (h : g.graph_has_cycle) :
    (List.range g.adj.size).any (fun u => g.reachB g.adj.size u) = true := by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨hlen0, hedges⟩, hlen1, hhl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨m, hmL⟩ : ∃ m, p.length = m + 1 := ⟨p.length - 1, by omega⟩
  have hm : 0 < m := by omega
  have hlast : p.getD m 0 = p.getD 0 0 := by
    have h1 := list_head?_eq p (by omega)
    have h2 := list_getLast?_eq p (by omega)
    rw [hmL] at h2
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h2
    rw [h1, h2] at hhl
    exact (Option.some_inj.mp hhl).symm
  have hedge : ∀ t, g.has_edge (p.getD (t % m) 0) (p.getD ((t + 1) % m) 0) := by
    intro t
    have hr : t % m < m := Nat.mod_lt _ hm
    have hmod : (t + 1) % m = (t % m + 1) % m := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 m with h2 | h2
      · rw [Nat.add_mod t 1 m, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2]
      · have hm1 : m = 1 := by omega
        subst hm1
        simp
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (t % m + 1) m with hlt | hge
    · rw [hmod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
      exact hedges (t % m) (by omega)
    · have heqm : t % m + 1 = m := by omega
      rw [hmod, heqm, Nat.mod_self]
      have hh := hedges (t % m) (by omega)
      rw [heqm, hlast] at hh
      exact hh
  have hstart : p.getD 0 0 < g.adj.size := by
    have hh : g.has_edge (p.getD 0 0) (p.getD (0 + 1) 0) := hedges 0 (by omega)
    have hh' : p.getD 0 0 < g.adj.size ∧ p.getD (0 + 1) 0 ∈ g.adj.getD (p.getD 0 0) #[] := hh
    exact hh'.1
  have hwalk := reachB_of_walk g g.adj.size (fun s => p.getD (s % m) 0)
    (fun t _ => hedge t)
  rw [List.any_eq_true]
  refine ⟨p.getD 0 0, List.mem_range.mpr hstart, ?_⟩
  simpa using hwalk
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem has_cycle_postcond_satisfied (graph : CycleGraph)
    (h_precond : has_cycle_precond graph) :
    has_cycle_postcond graph (has_cycle graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hdef : has_cycle graph h_precond
      = (List.range graph.adj.size).any (fun u => graph.reachB graph.adj.size u) := rfl
  have key : (has_cycle graph h_precond = true) ↔ graph.graph_has_cycle := by
    rw [hdef]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact sound_dir graph h_precond h
    · intro h
      exact complete_dir graph h
  exact propext key
  -- !benchmark @end proof

    g.reachB (k + 1) u = (g.succs u).any (fun v => g.reachB k v) := by

    | (simp [CycleGraph.reachB]; done)

lemma walk_of_reachB (g : CycleGraph) : ∀ (k u : Nat), g.reachB k u = true →
    ∃ f : Nat → Nat, f 0 = u ∧ ∀ i, i < k → g.has_edge (f i) (f (i + 1)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro u _
    exact ⟨fun _ => u, rfl, fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro u hu
    rw [reachB_succ, List.any_eq_true] at hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hrv⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hfe⟩ := ih v hrv

    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      have hedge : g.has_edge u v := (mem_succs_iff g u v).mp hv
      show g.has_edge u (f 0)
      rw [hf0]
      exact hedge
    | succ j =>
      show g.has_edge (f j) (f (j + 1))
      exact hfe j (by omega)

lemma reachB_of_walk (g : CycleGraph) : ∀ (k : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat),

  induction k with
  | zero => intro f _; exact reachB_zero g (f 0)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro f hf
    rw [reachB_succ, List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨f 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (mem_succs_iff g (f 0) (f 1)).mpr (hf 0 (Nat.succ_pos k))
    · have h2 := ih (fun i => f (i + 1)) (fun i hi => hf (i + 1) (by omega))

  have hbound : ∀ i, i ≤ g.adj.size → f i < g.adj.size := by
    intro i hi

    intro a ha

    · exact ⟨y, x, by omega, by omega, by omega, heq.symm⟩

      mkList_getD f (j - i) i (j - i) (le_refl _)]
    have e2 : i + (j - i) = j := by omega
    rw [e2, Nat.add_zero, hfij]

    (List.range g.adj.size).any (fun u => g.reachB g.adj.size u) = true := by

    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h2
